name: chloe-web-vintage
description: Chloe relationship-led sales portfolio — Vite frontend + Express TypeScript API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @chloe/frontend" "npm run dev -w @chloe/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chloe/frontend && npm run build -w @chloe/backend
scripts.check: npm run check -w @chloe/frontend && npm run check -w @chloe/backend
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm test
